about: Where trimixxx2's controls actually land, measured 2026-10-01 by pressing every control in order with `aseqdump -p TriMixxx` running. buttons: canonical note (MidiMap.hpp) -> the note this deck's S3 sends for it. lights: canonical note -> the note, or for a ring pad the node, its LED answers to; a pad's LED sits on the same board as its button, so the ring entries match. Ring A has an eighth pad, third in its chain (note 0x02): it has no function yet, so nothing is bound to it. PLAY and CUE are wired as standard. The jog encoder is wired the other way round (jogReversed). The panel sits flush, with no lip to keep clear (bezel). Its accent colour is pink, where Trimixxx1's is the skin's lime, so the two decks can be told apart at a glance (accent). Applied by upload.sh through apply.py; see ../README.md.
